ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: Winterfell
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: The ancestral seat of House Stark, commanding the heart of the North. Its walls and military traditions support a strong defensive garrison.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: Harrenhal
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: The immense, partly ruined fortress on the northern shore of the Gods Eye. It can house an enormous garrison, but its vast enclosure is expensive to restore and supply.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: King's Landing
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: The capital at the mouth of the Blackwater, with the Red Keep as its fortified heart. City and keep form one strategic estate, yielding exceptional wealth and political influence.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: Casterly Rock
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: The mighty western seat of House Lannister, fortified above the Sunset Sea and sustained by the wealth of the Westerlands.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: the Eyrie
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: House Arryn's mountaintop fortress in the Mountains of the Moon. Difficult approaches make it exceptionally defensible, though its small footprint limits recruitment and agriculture.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: Highgarden
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: House Tyrell's rich seat on the Mander, commanding fertile lands capable of supplying substantial levies and food taxes.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: Storm's End
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: The great coastal fortress overlooking Shipbreaker Bay. Its thick walls shelter a disciplined garrison against siege and storm.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: Sunspear
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: House Martell's seat on the southeastern coast of Dorne, commanding the shadow city and the surrounding Dornish lands.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: Riverrun
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: House Tully's castle at the meeting of the Red Fork and Tumblestone, guarding an important Riverlands junction.

ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.label: Dragonstone
ARimOfIceAndFire.Landmarks.HistoricalLan.description: The ancient Targaryen citadel on its volcanic island at the mouth of Blackwater Bay. Its dragon-carved black walls command the narrow-sea approaches, though the island limits farming and recruitment.

FactionDef.label: unclaimed landmark custodians
FactionDef.description: Local defenders of unclaimed historical landmarks, not a landed House or political owner.

WorldObjectDef.label: historical landmark
WorldObjectDef.description: A persistent strategic castle or city.

WorldObjectDef.label: landmark tax courier
WorldObjectDef.description: A courier carrying actual landmark taxes to a home base.

WorldObjectDef.label: landmark army
WorldObjectDef.description: An army travelling to contest a historical landmark.
